markdown_frontmatter.skills/notion/spec-to-implementation/SKI:
name: notion-spec-to-implementation
description: Turns product or tech specs into concrete Notion tasks that Claude code can implement. Breaks down spec pages into detailed implementation plans with clear tasks, acceptance criteria, and progress tracking to guide development from requirements to completion.
markdown_frontmatter.commands/search.md:
description: Search the user’s Notion workspace using the Notion MCP server and Notion Workspace Skill.
argument-hint: query terms
markdown_frontmatter.skills/notion/knowledge-capture/SKILL.md:
name: notion-knowledge-capture
description: Transforms conversations and discussions into structured documentation pages in Notion. Captures insights, decisions, and knowledge from chat context, formats appropriately, and saves to wikis or databases with proper organization and linking for easy discovery.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/notion/meeting-intelligence/SKILL:
name: notion-meeting-intelligence
description: Prepares meeting materials by gathering context from Notion, enriching with Claude research, and creating both an internal pre-read and external agenda saved to Notion. Helps you arrive prepared with comprehensive background and structured meeting docs.
markdown_frontmatter.commands/database-query.md:
description: Query a Notion database by name or ID and return structured, readable results.
argument-hint: 'database name or ID; filters (optional)'
markdown_frontmatter.commands/create-page.md:
description: Create a new Notion page, optionally under a specific parent, using the Notion Workspace Skill and Notion MCP server.
argument-hint: "Title of page [optional parent name or ID]"
markdown_frontmatter.skills/notion/research-documentation/SKI:
name: notion-research-documentation
description: Searches across your Notion workspace, synthesizes findings from multiple pages, and creates comprehensive research documentation saved as new Notion pages. Turns scattered information into structured reports with proper citations and actionable insights.
markdown_frontmatter.commands/find.md:
description: Quickly find pages or databases in Notion by title keywords.
argument-hint: query terms
markdown_frontmatter.commands/create-database-row.md:
description: Insert a new row into a specified Notion database using natural-language property values.
argument-hint: 'database name or ID; key=value properties'
markdown_frontmatter.commands/tasks/build.md:
description: Build a task from a Notion page URL
args: task_url
markdown_frontmatter.commands/tasks/explain-diff.md:
description: Makes a Notion doc explaining a code change.
args: task_url
markdown_frontmatter.commands/tasks/plan.md:
description: Plan a task from a Notion page URL
args: task_url
markdown_frontmatter.commands/tasks/setup.md: description: Set up a Notion task board for tracking tasks
markdown_frontmatter.commands/create-task.md:
description: Create a new task in the user’s Notion tasks database with sensible defaults.
argument-hint: 'task title; optional due date, status, owner, project'
